title: The Moon Knocks on the Tiger's Door
skyStory: The moon has charged into Aries, Joel's own sign, eighty percent lit and already wearing a cape. Mars, the ruler of Aries, has rolled out the red carpet, then set it slightly on fire for dramatic effect. Everything feels faster. Kettles boil sooner. The Tiger's ears are up and twitching. Even the November drizzle seems to be running late for something.

reading: Your sign, your moon, your home field. Today you can feel the crowd cheering, and the crowd is mostly made of your own good ideas chanting your name. Lovely. Now listen carefully to the [[Knight of Wands]]: aim. One target. A Tiger that pounces on everything catches nothing but air.

Choose the project that has been waiting the longest and give it one burst of glorious Aries energy before 2 pm. Not a plan, an actual push. After that, step away and let someone tell you it looks great. If you feel the urge to start something new around 5 pm, write it on a sticky note and stick it to tomorrow.
joel.mission: Wear something red, a sock counts, and roar quietly at your reflection once before leaving the house.
joel.omen: A red car pulling out of a spot exactly as you arrive. The way is clearing; take it.
joel.stoneWhy: your own stone, home for a visit

reading: The moon has gone to visit Joel's side of the map and the Fire is going to be extra loud today. You may receive a burst of messages with too many exclamation marks. This is weather. Enjoy it like a bonfire on the beach: warm, a bit wild, best enjoyed from a comfortable distance.

Borrow some of that Aries spark for yourself. One thing you have been patiently waiting on deserves a nudge today, not a polite nudge, a cheerful shove. Saturn says patience is noble. Mars says patience has had its turn. You get to decide, and the ruby on your pinky is quietly voting for Mars.
nancy.mission: Send one message today that starts with 'Right, let's do this' and actually mean it.
nancy.omen: A fireplace glowing through a stranger's window. The Fire is thinking of you from somewhere warm.
nancy.stoneWhy: carrying his fire on his day

together.text: Joel sends Nancy one bold idea in exactly seven words. Nancy replies with one bold idea in exactly eleven, for her Life Path. No explaining allowed. Then each picks the idea they like best from the other and takes one tiny step toward it before bed.

game.intro: The moon knocked on the Tiger's door tonight. Mars answered. It was loud. Your turn to be loud.
game.prompt: A big cat waking up from a nap and finding out dinner is late.
